scope: Read-only frontend ownership, request/session presentation, URL consent/completion, authentication/opening cancellation and late callbacks. No product/test edits and no tests/browser rerun by reviewer.
conclusion: No remaining blocking finding in the reviewed frontend scope after the cancellation-unknown enabled-card issue was fixed and rechecked.

covered.finding: URL shape gate requires HTTPS host, no credentials/control characters/backslash; host/full URL and punycode notice displayed as text. No prefetch, remote anchor/embed or opener before explicit choice.

Opener pending, submitted reply, external completion and parent outcome remain separate. Current object/owner checked before opener and after await; one response in flight; timeout/unknown receipt does not auto-repeat. Stopping/stopUnconfirmed blocks thread replies.

Authentication Channel stays attached to initiating attempt. An inquiry completion only removes its card and adds a qualified notice; it does not set operationConfirmed/checked. Parent cancellation/end and late callbacks retain attempt checks.

Before session_open result, inquiries go to a transient opening owner; same pending open joins current interests. Abort epoch prevents an old opener acknowledgement being accepted by a new caller. Retire attempts cancellation and states original outcome still unknown; parent finish/normal channel handoff remain distinct.

Final dedicated active/unmount abort path withdraws opening inquiry without changing existing prepared-draft lifetime. Preparation ticket/phase and send fallback dynamic active/pair guard prevent stale consent. App navigation synchronously retires opening owners.
One generic form/URL card is used in opening, authentication and conversation locations. Unknown request details remain inert text and in-memory only; no Agent brand UI branch introduced.

findingClosed.prior: cancel/endConnection set startCancelled=true then failed IPC yields phase unknown. Runtime correctly refused replies, but AuthElicitationList only checked checking/cancelling and re-enabled the pending card, leaving inert enabled actions. editInquiry also lacked matching cancellation guard.
findingClosed.fix: AuthElicitationList disabled now checks activity.canStart(job.attemptId); editInquiry checks current attempt, authActive and phase.

validRed.why: Actual rendered buttons had no disabled attribute after either cancellation failure.

green.review: Read new test and production diff, verified raw exit 0; not rerun by reviewer.

browserEvidence.qualification: Chromium React StrictMode and actual generic UI; native IPC/opener mocked. This log does not execute actual browser authorization, native app, account, Agent or installed binary. Later change was cancellation-disabled guard plus dedicated source/SSR regression; browser was not rerun for it.

remainingBoundaries: Backend/wire independent review belongs to root; limited producer/helper reads here only checked frontend identity assumptions.
Standard form/URL scope support is not proof of every Agent login surface or private authentication extension.
No native account/Agent journey or installed-product URL acceptance claimed.
Read-only review does not replace root frozen-input full checks or final installation verification.
